author: Killswitch-_-
quote: 13 years of waiting just for Rockstar to bend the knee to woke activists and gut everything that made Grand Theft Auto legendary. They stripped away classic GTA freedom and turned a ruthless crime franchise into a pathetic "good boy" simulator doing chores, managing a relationship meter, and simping for a partner who hid your own kid. And charging full price for a 30 FPS lock in 2026 is straight up disrespect to the fanbase. Rockstar completely sold out
